limitations: No original-game execution observed by this exporter. User reference screenshots are separate supplied observations.
Source rectangles and bitmap indices are preserved; remaining event binding and exact animation ordering need native code/runtime corroboration.
CAP image paths describe original editor inputs, which are not present. MNU embedded pixels supply the exported images.
Original native alpha blends integer RGB565/RGB555 channels with truncation. Exported RGBA uses the confirmed 255-raw opacity, so browser 8-bit blending may differ slightly at intermediate opacity.

mnu_alpha_rule.additional_mode: Exported MNU bitmap groups have serialized byte+0x24=0; fixed half-transparent/additive overrides are absent for these resources.

actor_bar.limit: The source MNU is a blurred editor template with fixed 英格妮. Runtime actor panels come from Menu_Role_Board.DGP and retain each actor name.

slot_icons.binding_limit: Labels are read from the decoded frame pixels; native item-slot action binding is a separate requirement.

item_card_dispatcher.behavior: Match definition bytes +0x24/+0x25 to the original category type/subtype, load its nonempty DGP path, and draw definition u32+0x20 minus one. Empty paths and unmatched types have no borrowed card image.

actor_panel_source.binding: Source frame is native actor index. Nonzero widget state adds six; frame0/1 are clear and frame6/7 blurred as observed in the source pixels and user reference screenshots.

001.state_alias_limit: normal/selected/unfocused are visual aliases matched to supplied screenshots. The literal native widget state is separately preserved in actor_panel_source.binding; high-level focus-to-widget-state ordering remains under verification.
